title: PCA Studio — PCA9685 sequencer & tester
_comment: PCA Studio is BUILT, like the sim, and for the same reason: the engine
and the sequences.h generator used to exist as a hand-kept copy inside
PCA-Studio.html, and a hand-kept copy is a copy that eventually differs.
Two of the three copies are now one file, shared from src/js/maestro.
Paths are relative to the REPO ROOT, so a shared module reads as what it
is. Order matters — each file becomes its own <script>.
Output is a single self-contained pca-studio/PCA-Studio.html: still one
file you open from disk with no server. Run ./build.sh after editing.
